head_commit.message:
fix(record): record-autofix stages dev/programme/delivery; friction lane spawns the moved policy_lint

The delivery rows moved to dev/programme/delivery/ but record-autofix still ran 'git add docs/delivery' (matches nothing, so every beat read nothing-owed and record stayed red on main), and its entities pin hard-coded the same spelling. friction_issues.mjs spawned .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs, which no longer exists, so the record job's friction step refused. The pin now derives the directory from record_row.row_path; the friction self-test pins the spawned tool on disk.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The hold clamp uses the configured ceiling, and the floor test and the
unmetered return are one-line sites. The changed-line draw is those
sites, each killed by the features.py check that names it.
